seed.name: corvane-acquisition
seed.question: I hold some shares of Corvane Therapeutics (ticker CRVN). Someone told me it's being bought out. Is that true? If so, by whom, at what price, and when is it expected to close? Please check current sources online and cite the URLs you used.
facts: Corvane Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotech company in Cambridge, Massachusetts, listed on Nasdaq as CRVN. Its website is www.corvane.com.
Corvane's lead drug candidate is CVT-118, an oral treatment for idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis in Phase 2b trials.
Ostrand Pharma is a pharmaceutical company in Basel, Switzerland. Its website is www.ostrandpharma.com.
On 2026-10-01, Ostrand Pharma and Corvane Therapeutics announced that Ostrand will acquire Corvane for $41.50 per share in cash.
The deal values Corvane at about $2.3 billion, a 64% premium to Corvane's closing price on 2026-09-30.
The acquisition is expected to close in the first quarter of 2027, subject to regulatory approval and a vote of Corvane shareholders.
